name: Cosmic Forger (Cerebremancer Prestige Class)
body:
The cosmic forger is an expert at combining effects both magical and technological to produce powerful pieces of equipment.

The following is an archetype of the cerebremancer prestige class.

Requirements

A character wishing to become a cosmic forger must meet the following prerequisites:

Skills: Knowledge (arcana) 3 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 3 ranks.
Feats: Any one item creation feat.
Spellcasting: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells.
Psionics: Ability to manifest 2nd-level powers or form an astral suit.
Class Features

The following are class features of this prestige class.

Skills

The cosmic forger adds Knowledge (engineering) to his list of class skills.

This alters class skills.

Spells per Day/Powers Known

When a new cosmic forger level is attained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also attained a level in any one arcane spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class. He gains additional power points per day and access to new powers as if he had also gained a level in any one manifesting class he belonged to previously. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of either class would have gained (bonus metamagic, metapsionic, or item creation feats, and so on).

This essentially means that he adds the level of cosmic forger to the level of whatever other arcane spellcasting class and manifesting class the character has, then determines spells per day, caster level, power points per day, powers known, and manifester level accordingly.

If a character had more than one arcane spellcasting class or more than one manifesting class before he became a cosmic forger, he must decide to which class he adds each level of cosmic forger for purpose of determining spells per day, caster level, power points per day, powers known, and manifester level. If the cosmic forger possesses the ability to form an astral suit, he may add his cosmic forger level to his aegis level for the purpose of determining the abilities of his astral suit rather than adding it to a psionic manifesting class.

Crafting Mastery (Ex)

At 1st level and every odd-numbered level thereafter, the cosmic forger gains a bonus item creation feat that he meets the prerequisites for. Alternatively, at any level when he would gain an item creation feat, he may instead choose to reduce the cost of crafting items with a specific item creation feat by 10%.

This ability replaces magical manifesting.

Combined Utility

At 2nd level, the cosmic forger learns how to combine technological and magical equipment into a single device, allowing them to utilize both at the same time. At the same price of creating an item, a cosmic forger may add the abilities of the item to another item which takes up the same slot. The cosmic forger must possess the item creation feats needed for both, pay the full material costs (alongside other requisite resources) for both items, make crafting checks for both items, and use the longer crafting time between the two items. For example, a cosmic forger may create a white force field and then add the abilities of bracers of armor +4. When someone wears the combined item on his Wrists slot, he gains the benefits of both pieces of equipment. A combined item cannot be made up of more than 2 items and the total gp value of any combined item the cosmic forger creates cannot exceed 10,000 gp per cosmic forger level.

At 6th level, the cosmic forger gains the ability to combine two of the same item. Their benefits do not stack (for example, combining two force fields would only grant you the bonus of the larger benefit), but their uses may (for example, combining two spectacles of annihilation would allow you to use the item’s 1/day ability twice as often at 2/day).

This ability replaces mind over magic.
